note: Triage catalogue, not a ranking score or exhaustive engine specification. Priority hints must be adjusted to observed impact and site intent. Read source register and relevant reference before applying a check.

rules.title: Confirm desired index state
rules.evidence_test: Compare business intent with route purpose and owner decisions.
rules.remediation: Record intended indexable, excluded, private, moved or removed states.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Exclusion is not intrinsically an error.
rules.verification: Owner-reviewed inventory agrees with the audit scope.

rules.title: Reconcile coverage
rules.evidence_test: Compare route/CMS, sitemap, crawl and available search/log inventories.
rules.remediation: Create a provenance-preserving union and expose unresolved differences.
rules.false_positive_caveat: One export is not necessarily a complete site inventory.
rules.verification: Report known, fetched, rendered, engine-inspected and manually assessed counts separately.

rules.title: Preserve business rules and approvals
rules.evidence_test: Read project instructions, acceptance criteria and deployment permissions.
rules.remediation: Escalate conflicts; implement only authorised changes.
rules.false_positive_caveat: SEO preference does not override privacy or product behaviour.
rules.verification: Review diff, approvals and unchanged relevant business tests.

rules.title: Keep evidence and source freshness
rules.evidence_test: Check source date, engine, market, observed evidence and confidence.
rules.remediation: Reopen primary guidance and label unavailable or uncertain evidence.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A vendor warning or stale source is not a verified violation.
rules.verification: Each finding has traceable evidence and a current applicable source.

rules.title: Verify successful intended public responses
rules.evidence_test: Fetch direct and representative variant URLs; capture status and content.
rules.remediation: Fix unintended availability failures at the owning route, origin or edge.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A successful fetch does not establish indexing; intentional removals differ.
rules.verification: Re-fetch deployed pages and verify meaningful content and correct status.

rules.title: Detect false-success error pages
rules.evidence_test: Compare body/error state with actual response code.
rules.remediation: Return an appropriate missing/error response or restore the intended content.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A snapshot cannot by itself prove Google classified a soft 404.
rules.verification: Test existing, missing and upstream-failure routes.

rules.title: Control redirect loops and irrelevant destinations
rules.evidence_test: Capture redirect chains and test destination equivalence.
rules.remediation: Use coherent direct redirects to relevant destinations; remove loops.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Not every redirect is wrong; temporary and permanent moves differ.
rules.verification: Test old routes, query handling and final response/content.

rules.title: Keep protocol and host signals coherent
rules.evidence_test: Compare redirects, canonicals, sitemaps and internal URLs.
rules.remediation: Align preferred public variants without losing valid alternate services.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Distinct subdomains can serve legitimate separate purposes.
rules.verification: Check variant matrix and deployed signals.

rules.title: Evaluate robots rules for each crawler
rules.evidence_test: Read exact host robots response and applicable user-agent group.
rules.remediation: Correct unintended matching rules using a tested robots evaluator.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Disallow is not a security boundary or guaranteed deindexing.
rules.verification: Verify matching examples and accessible intended resources.

rules.title: Noindex must be readable
rules.evidence_test: Compare crawling permission with actual exclusion headers/meta.
rules.remediation: Choose a coherent owner-approved crawl and exclusion strategy.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Do not remove legitimate access protection to expose private content.
rules.verification: Confirm intended crawler can read exclusion where that is the chosen mechanism.

rules.title: Respect directive scope and aliases
rules.applicability: Robots meta and repeated X-Robots-Tag headers
rules.evidence_test: Parse crawler scope and noindex/none without last-tag-wins assumptions.
rules.remediation: Remove accidental contradictions at their source.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Google body-meta recognition must not be assumed for every engine.
rules.verification: Test scoped headers, body/head tags and initial/rendered variants.

rules.title: Protect private and staging environments
rules.evidence_test: Inspect authentication, exposure and environment-dependent metadata.
rules.remediation: Preserve access controls and stop production/staging configuration leakage.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Robots and snippet restrictions do not protect confidential data.
rules.verification: Test unauthenticated access and production canonical/exclusion configuration.

rules.title: Make canonical declarations coherent
rules.evidence_test: Compare head and HTTP Link canonicals, response, links and sitemaps.
rules.remediation: Choose consistent genuine equivalents and remove conflicting declarations.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A canonical is a signal; the engine may select another URL.
rules.verification: Re-fetch declarations and inspect engine-selected canonical where available.

rules.title: Avoid invalid canonical destinations
rules.evidence_test: Test resolved destination, status, access and content equivalence.
rules.remediation: Point to the intended available equivalent and fix dependent signals.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Relative resolution and base elements can change the actual destination.
rules.verification: Check final URLs, headers and comparable content.

rules.title: Do not use noindex as consolidation
rules.evidence_test: Inspect whether noindex is being used to express a preferred duplicate.
rules.remediation: Use appropriate canonical or redirect strategy for the actual lifecycle.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Intentionally excluding a page can still be valid for other reasons.
rules.verification: Verify owner intent and coherent consolidation signals.

rules.title: Review missing canonicals without overclaiming
rules.applicability: Pages with no explicit canonical observed
rules.evidence_test: Inspect both HTML and headers and ask whether explicit guidance is useful.
rules.remediation: Add consistent declarations when justified by the URL model.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Missing explicit markup does not prove canonicalisation failure.
rules.verification: Validate output and compare actual engine canonical when available.

rules.title: Validate sitemap format and limits
rules.evidence_test: Check namespace, absolute URL format, count and uncompressed size.
rules.remediation: Generate compliant bounded files and an index when necessary.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Offline XML validity does not verify server delivery or all extensions.
rules.verification: Run local lint and inspect actual served response.

rules.title: Publish intended preferred URLs
rules.evidence_test: Compare entries with desired state, response, canonical and environment.
rules.remediation: Remove accidental obsolete/private/variant entries and add missing desired ones.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Sitemap inclusion does not guarantee indexing.
rules.verification: Compare generated entries with reconciled canonical inventory.

rules.title: Use trustworthy last modification dates
rules.evidence_test: Compare dates with substantive page changes and publishing records.
rules.remediation: Use reliable modification data or omit unsupported values.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A syntactically valid date may still be misleading.
rules.verification: Spot-check actual changes, future values and generation logic.

rules.title: Inspect sitemap discovery and processing
rules.evidence_test: Check served files, authorised submission/reporting and robots references.
rules.remediation: Fix inaccessible files or erroneous locations through approved processes.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A sitemap acceptance response is not an indexed-page count.
rules.verification: Record engine processing state and subsequent URL evidence separately.

rules.title: Prevent unbounded URL spaces
rules.applicability: Facets, calendars, sessions and generated search states
rules.evidence_test: Use crawl/log evidence to find repeated low-value parameter combinations.
rules.remediation: Design coherent route/link/index controls with product owners.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Do not strip functional parameters or suppress useful landing pages blindly.
rules.verification: Test valuable combinations and trap boundaries.

rules.title: Prioritise crawl budget proportionately
rules.applicability: Large or frequently changing sites with crawl evidence
rules.evidence_test: Measure scale, waste, error rate and important discovery delay.
rules.remediation: Address demonstrated bottlenecks rather than optimising an imaginary quota.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A small stable site may have no meaningful crawl-budget problem.
rules.verification: Compare equivalent logs and discovery evidence after the fix.

rules.title: Check direct and client navigated routes
rules.evidence_test: Compare initial HTML, rendered direct loads and route transitions.
rules.remediation: Fix route/data delivery using the existing framework architecture.
rules.false_positive_caveat: JavaScript itself is not evidence that content is invisible.
rules.verification: Browser and response tests show correct content on each path.

rules.title: Avoid relying on JS to remove initial noindex
rules.evidence_test: Compare initial and rendered directives.
rules.remediation: Generate the intended initial directive instead of relying on later removal.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A rendered clean DOM does not erase the risk in the initial response.
rules.verification: Assert correct initial and rendered policy on representative routes.

rules.title: Keep canonical stable through hydration
rules.evidence_test: Compare initial and rendered canonical declarations.
rules.remediation: Use a coherent route-specific canonical without conflicting mutations.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Dynamically supplied canonical is not automatically invalid.
rules.verification: Test deep links and client transitions against expected values.

rules.title: Serve required render resources reliably
rules.evidence_test: Observe blocked or failing resources and the resulting DOM.
rules.remediation: Fix unintended resource access or delivery failures.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Do not expose confidential APIs or bypass auth for a crawler.
rules.verification: Repeat affected render scenarios with network evidence.

rules.title: Make route metadata specific and current
rules.evidence_test: Compare title/canonical/schema after visiting multiple routes.
rules.remediation: Repair the owning metadata layer and remove accidental duplicated output.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A default fallback can be appropriate for some utility states.
rules.verification: Run direct-load and navigation regression tests.

rules.title: Preserve meaningful mobile content and signals
rules.evidence_test: Compare primary text, links, directives and structured data.
rules.remediation: Restore unintentionally missing mobile material without forcing identical layout.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Responsive presentation changes are not inherently content loss.
rules.verification: Verify representative mobile/desktop routes and equivalent tasks.

rules.title: Check overlays and practical mobile journeys
rules.evidence_test: Observe reading, navigation and conversion through overlays and consent states.
rules.remediation: Reduce unnecessary obstruction while retaining required protections.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Do not remove legal/security/consent functionality for a metric.
rules.verification: Retest narrow viewport, keyboard and essential flows.

rules.title: Use crawlable relevant links
rules.evidence_test: Inspect actual anchors/href destinations and route accessibility.
rules.remediation: Provide meaningful links and fix broken important destinations.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A UI button is not wrong when it performs an action rather than navigation.
rules.verification: Check rendered link discovery and user behaviour.

rules.title: Investigate important orphan candidates
rules.applicability: Inventory URLs absent from the observed link graph
rules.evidence_test: Compare crawl scope, rendering coverage, navigation and sitemaps.
rules.remediation: Add useful contextual/navigation paths where a real gap is confirmed.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Absence in a partial crawl does not establish an orphan.
rules.verification: Re-crawl relevant entry points and verify meaningful reachability.

rules.title: Use understandable anchor text
rules.evidence_test: Review destination meaning in surrounding prose and image-link text.
rules.remediation: Replace misleading labels naturally without exact-match quotas.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Repeated navigation labels and short conventional labels may be appropriate.
rules.verification: Review real reading/navigation context.

rules.title: Keep paginated pages meaningfully discoverable
rules.evidence_test: Inspect stable page URLs, links, content differences and canonical policy.
rules.remediation: Expose coherent pagination and avoid canonicalising distinct pages to page one.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Not every UI state needs independent indexing.
rules.verification: Test first, middle, last and empty/error pagination states.

rules.title: Classify facets by actual user value
rules.evidence_test: Compare need, inventory, duplication and unbounded combinations.
rules.remediation: Keep justified landing needs and control redundant/trap states coherently.
rules.false_positive_caveat: High search volume alone does not justify an empty or weak landing page.
rules.verification: Validate selected combinations, links, controls and canonical inventory.

rules.title: Qualify sponsored and UGC links appropriately
rules.evidence_test: Inspect real relationship and current engine attribute guidance.
rules.remediation: Apply appropriate relationship attributes without disguising payment.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Not every external editorial link needs nofollow.
rules.verification: Inspect rendered links and policy alignment.

rules.title: Define each page’s user task
rules.evidence_test: Read the page and record audience, purpose and useful next step.
rules.remediation: Improve the answer or consolidate only with a defensible user rationale.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Low traffic or short length alone does not establish low value.
rules.verification: An editorial reviewer can complete the stated task.

rules.title: Provide a verifiable original contribution
rules.evidence_test: Identify original facts, experience, tool value or useful interpretation.
rules.remediation: Obtain real evidence or narrow unsupported claims.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Originality does not require inventing a personal experience.
rules.verification: Review claim sources and the page’s distinct useful contribution.

rules.title: Avoid scaled low-value content
rules.applicability: Bulk pages or automated content programmes
rules.evidence_test: Inspect purpose, duplication, factual support and actual user value.
rules.remediation: Stop manipulative bulk production; improve or propose a limited useful scope.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Automation or AI use alone is not the violation.
rules.verification: Human-approved briefs and sampled factual/editorial checks show substance.

rules.title: No keyword or entity stuffing
rules.applicability: Copy, metadata, links and image text
rules.evidence_test: Read for unnatural repetition, irrelevant names and hidden terms.
rules.remediation: Use precise natural language relevant to the real subject.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Legitimate repeated terminology or factual brand comparison is not automatically spam.
rules.verification: Editorial review confirms clarity and relevance without quotas.

rules.title: Use accurate distinctive page titles
rules.evidence_test: Compare titles with actual page purpose and other relevant templates.
rules.remediation: Replace empty/misleading defaults with useful route-specific titles.
rules.false_positive_caveat: No fixed character limit guarantees display or rank.
rules.verification: Inspect deployed title and sensible template variants.

rules.title: Write useful descriptions where worthwhile
rules.evidence_test: Review existing summaries and actual page value.
rules.remediation: Write truthful concise summaries without keyword lists.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Missing description is not proof of exclusion; engines may choose different snippets.
rules.verification: Check metadata output and factual agreement with the page.

rules.title: Use headings and length for readers
rules.evidence_test: Assess navigability, hierarchy, completeness and unnecessary repetition.
rules.remediation: Use structure and detail proportionate to the task.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Multiple H1s and short copy are not automatic ranking violations.
rules.verification: Editorial/accessibility review rather than arbitrary count thresholds.

rules.title: Keep attribution and expertise truthful
rules.evidence_test: Verify real author/reviewer involvement and material sources.
rules.remediation: Add only genuine attribution and seek suitable expert review when needed.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A synthetic author bio or credentials cannot establish trust.
rules.verification: Review owner approval and claim provenance.

rules.title: Update facts rather than cosmetic dates
rules.evidence_test: Compare changed claims/data with publication and modification records.
rules.remediation: Correct stale information and date updates honestly.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A new date alone is not a substantive improvement.
rules.verification: Diff and source log show actual reviewed changes.

rules.title: Make FAQs earn their place
rules.evidence_test: Identify real unresolved reader questions and evidence provenance.
rules.remediation: Answer naturally in context or a useful FAQ; reject filler.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A model-generated question is not proof of demand.
rules.verification: Each answer is accurate, nonredundant and useful for the task.

rules.title: Label query evidence provenance
rules.evidence_test: Check observation versus provider estimate versus user input versus model idea.
rules.remediation: Attach source, date, scope and uncertainty to every material candidate.
rules.false_positive_caveat: LLM plausibility is not observed search demand.
rules.verification: Keyword ledger contains no fabricated metric or source.

rules.title: Preserve metric definitions
rules.applicability: Keyword volumes, Trends, Ads or vendor difficulty
rules.evidence_test: Record provider, market, date range, units and method limits.
rules.remediation: Keep unknowns null and avoid cross-tool conversions without evidence.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Relative interest, Ads competition and organic difficulty are different.
rules.verification: Review metric provenance and labels in the research deliverable.

rules.title: Inspect actual search intent evidence
rules.evidence_test: Observe representative results and inspect relevant destinations.
rules.remediation: Record result formats/tasks and separate observation from interpretation.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Generic search-tool output may not reproduce a local Google/Bing SERP.
rules.verification: Ledger has engine/tool, query, date, locale and limitations.

rules.title: Do not define long-tail by word count
rules.evidence_test: Review available demand evidence and candidate specificity.
rules.remediation: Use demand-tail terminology only when supportable; otherwise label specificity.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A long phrase can be popular and a short one obscure.
rules.verification: Classification includes evidence or an explicit unverified status.

rules.title: Map intent before creating URLs
rules.evidence_test: Compare user task, existing destination and observed result overlap.
rules.remediation: Improve an existing page or propose a genuinely distinct useful destination.
rules.false_positive_caveat: One keyword does not require one page.
rules.verification: Intent map explains page boundaries and rejected duplicates.

rules.title: Investigate rather than assume cannibalisation
rules.evidence_test: Review intent, URL purpose, conversions and changing visibility.
rules.remediation: Consolidate only when evidence supports harmful overlap.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Multiple URLs may legitimately serve different tasks.
rules.verification: Document the rationale and post-change outcome measures.

rules.title: Prioritise business-fit opportunities
rules.evidence_test: Compare demand evidence, offering fit, unique contribution, effort and dependencies.
rules.remediation: Select a limited justified backlog and defer irrelevant topics.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Popularity is not business value or attainable ranking.
rules.verification: Each recommendation has a written rationale and owner.

rules.title: Build fact-checkable briefs
rules.evidence_test: Review task, evidence, claims needed, existing coverage and success criteria.
rules.remediation: Use the brief template with sources and explicit prohibited unsupported claims.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A competitor outline is not a unique contribution.
rules.verification: Editor can implement without inventing facts or demand.

rules.title: Check actual feature eligibility
rules.evidence_test: Open current feature documentation and compare the real page model.
rules.remediation: Use only truthful applicable types and properties.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Schema vocabulary validity does not establish feature support or display.
rules.verification: Record syntax, feature and visible-content checks separately.

rules.title: Keep markup consistent with visible truth
rules.evidence_test: Compare real facts and visible page with structured values.
rules.remediation: Fix the shared source of truth instead of inventing missing fields.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A successful JSON parse does not verify truth or completeness.
rules.verification: Test sample routes and missing/stale-data states.

rules.title: Validate rendered JSON and duplicate entities
rules.evidence_test: Parse JSON and inspect types/IDs across initial and rendered output.
rules.remediation: Repair syntax/serialisation and conflicting template emissions.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Repeated entities can be intentional; parser checks are not rich-result certification.
rules.verification: Run current appropriate validators and review semantic identity.

rules.title: Do not promise retired FAQ rich results
rules.evidence_test: Recheck current Google feature status before promising enhancement.
rules.remediation: Keep useful answers; do not use fake QAPage to replace retired support.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Other consumers may still have a use for the vocabulary.
rules.verification: Brief and implementation make no unsupported Google display promise.

rules.title: Do not fabricate reviews or rating eligibility
rules.evidence_test: Verify provenance, actual reviewed entity and current type-specific policy.
rules.remediation: Use real eligible material and remove misleading values with approval.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Selected first-party testimonials do not automatically qualify for stars.
rules.verification: Record reviewer/source and feature-policy validation.

rules.title: Keep product facts and offers aligned
rules.evidence_test: Compare visible offer, structured data and available feed/catalogue records.
rules.remediation: Repair price, currency, availability and product identifiers at source.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Valid syntax alone cannot detect commercial inaccuracy.
rules.verification: Test relevant markets, missing values and stock changes.

rules.title: Model meaningful product variants
rules.evidence_test: Inspect variant semantics, URL policy and current markup requirements.
rules.remediation: Represent genuine differences consistently with page and feed data.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Not every colour requires a separate indexable landing page.
rules.verification: Check representative variants and canonical decisions.

rules.title: Provide a coherent catalogue hierarchy
rules.evidence_test: Trace useful category-to-product paths and pagination.
rules.remediation: Make important products reachable through meaningful links.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A flat XML inventory does not replace user navigation.
rules.verification: Re-crawl relevant catalogue paths and test the shopping journey.

rules.title: Handle unavailable products intentionally
rules.evidence_test: Review temporary/permanent state and support/traffic dependencies.
rules.remediation: Choose truthful retention, relevant successor or appropriate removal.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Not every unavailable item should redirect to a category/homepage.
rules.verification: Verify status, content, links and customer next steps.

rules.title: Protect transactional and account routes
rules.applicability: Cart, checkout, account and operational routes
rules.evidence_test: Compare desired privacy/exclusion with actual exposure.
rules.remediation: Retain appropriate protections and isolate public-template rules.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Maximising indexed URLs is not a goal for private shopping states.
rules.verification: Test unauthenticated behaviour and public product indexing controls.

rules.title: Represent real locations and services
rules.evidence_test: Verify the actual operating footprint and unique local usefulness.
rules.remediation: Use accurate local details; reject invented offices and doorway variants.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Serving an area does not imply a staffed physical branch.
rules.verification: Owner validates claims and destination usefulness.

rules.title: Reconcile authorised business-profile facts
rules.evidence_test: Compare site/profile name, services, hours and contact facts.
rules.remediation: Prepare accurate policy-compliant corrections for approval.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A website audit is not permission to edit accounts.
rules.verification: Verify published facts only after authorised changes.

rules.title: Keep local expectations realistic
rules.evidence_test: Record target market, real reach and business capabilities.
rules.remediation: Prioritise useful accurate information and qualified contacts.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Repeating cities cannot guarantee overcoming distance/context.
rules.verification: Review locality-specific observations and conversion evidence.

rules.title: Use real localised destinations
rules.evidence_test: Inspect content, offering and stable URLs for each intended market.
rules.remediation: Localise substance and permit useful version discovery.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Translated keywords do not establish local demand or service availability.
rules.verification: Review actual language/market routes and search evidence.

rules.title: Validate alternate-language clusters
rules.evidence_test: Check reciprocal/self references, codes, resolved targets and canonical consistency.
rules.remediation: Generate coherent alternate sets from the locale source of truth.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Not every site needs x-default or multiple regions.
rules.verification: Test full representative clusters and target status.

rules.title: Do not canonicalise distinct translations away
rules.evidence_test: Compare language content and chosen canonical policy.
rules.remediation: Preserve intended language pages and appropriate alternate signals.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Same-language regional duplicates need case-specific decisions.
rules.verification: Inspect canonical/hreflang combinations and available engine evidence.

rules.title: Test locale routing and caching
rules.evidence_test: Request direct variants with fresh sessions and relevant cache paths.
rules.remediation: Fix locale leakage and inappropriate forced redirection.
rules.false_positive_caveat: User preference handling can be legitimate if discovery remains coherent.
rules.verification: Validate correct content, pricing and metadata per route.

rules.title: Use meaningful image text and empty decorative alt
rules.evidence_test: Distinguish missing alt, informative purpose and decorative purpose.
rules.remediation: Write concise relevant alt or retain empty alt when decorative.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Empty alt is not automatically an SEO defect.
rules.verification: Human review of purpose plus actual markup verification.

rules.title: Make useful images discoverable and efficient
rules.evidence_test: Inspect response, rendered image URLs, lazy loading and relevant metadata.
rules.remediation: Fix inaccessible assets and use sensible delivery with rights preserved.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A sitemap or preferred image declaration does not guarantee a thumbnail.
rules.verification: Check actual image discovery and page experience.

rules.title: Distinguish watch pages from incidental embeds
rules.evidence_test: Inspect page purpose, playback, thumbnail and current eligibility.
rules.remediation: Provide a useful truthful video destination and appropriate metadata.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Any embedded clip does not automatically qualify its page for video features.
rules.verification: Verify playback/discovery and current feature tests.

rules.title: Represent editorial dates and ownership honestly
rules.evidence_test: Compare publication/modification claims with editorial records.
rules.remediation: Maintain real attribution, corrections and substantive freshness.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Changing dates does not create a newsworthy update.
rules.verification: Editor approves date/claim provenance.

rules.title: Respect paywall delivery and marking
rules.evidence_test: Compare legitimate visitor/crawler experience with current paywall guidance.
rules.remediation: Represent the actual access model without exposing protected material.
rules.false_positive_caveat: An access limitation is not automatically an SEO bug.
rules.verification: Authorised access tests and current marking validation pass.

rules.title: Moderate UGC and generated-page abuse
rules.applicability: Forums, reviews, profiles and public search
rules.evidence_test: Inspect spam, exposed data and low-value generated route patterns.
rules.remediation: Fix abuse controls and truthful page modelling before index cosmetics.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Genuine user discussion is not interchangeable with editorial FAQ.
rules.verification: Verify moderation workflow and representative clean/abuse states.

rules.title: Use actual field Core Web Vitals
rules.evidence_test: Record p75 LCP/INP/CLS with window, device and URL/origin scope.
rules.remediation: Address measured bottlenecks and label missing field evidence unknown.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A lab score or origin group is not a measurement of every URL.
rules.verification: Compare appropriate field cohorts after deployment.

rules.title: Use current good-threshold definitions
rules.evidence_test: Check current metric definitions and units before classifying.
rules.remediation: Use LCP 2.5s, INP 200ms and CLS 0.1 good boundaries at p75 as documented.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Metrics, aggregation and thresholds must be reverified if guidance changes.
rules.verification: Record all relevant metrics with scope and no missing-as-pass substitutions.

rules.title: Keep lab diagnostics separate from field outcomes
rules.evidence_test: Record environment and repeated observations; distinguish TBT from INP.
rules.remediation: Diagnose reproducible causes without presenting lab scores as ranking scores.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A lab page-load run cannot establish actual field INP.
rules.verification: Repeat representative tests and later inspect field data.

rules.title: Protect usability during performance work
rules.evidence_test: Review primary content, interactions, layout and required controls.
rules.remediation: Fix bottlenecks without breaking consent, security, accessibility or conversions.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Removing important functionality can make metrics look better but harm the site.
rules.verification: Run functional/visual/accessibility regression checks with timing tests.

rules.title: Reject manipulative link and reputation schemes
rules.evidence_test: Check payment, deception, impersonation and automated spam.
rules.remediation: Use genuine relevant contributions and transparent relationships.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Legitimate advertising is different from disguising ranking-credit purchases.
rules.verification: Owner-reviewed plan respects current policies and permissions.

rules.title: Do not treat vendor link scores as engine verdicts
rules.evidence_test: Inspect provider scope and real referring-page evidence.
rules.remediation: Investigate rather than automatically disavowing or deleting assets.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A proprietary warning is not a manual action or proof of a penalty.
rules.verification: Evidence supports any proposed high-risk action and approval is recorded.

rules.title: Preserve report dimensions and definitions
rules.evidence_test: Record engine, property, time zone, date, search type and filters.
rules.remediation: Keep unlike datasets separate and explain provider differences.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Search exposure, sessions and logs are not identical measures.
rules.verification: Every table states scope and cannot silently combine incompatible data.

rules.title: Calculate CTR from totals
rules.evidence_test: Check totals and whether percentages were averaged unweighted.
rules.remediation: Calculate clicks divided by impressions within compatible groups.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Zero impressions means undefined CTR, not proof of poor performance.
rules.verification: Recompute with known fixtures and disclose aggregation limits.

rules.title: Prevent duplicate and overlapping aggregation
rules.evidence_test: Check unique row keys, overlapping windows and totals mixed with detail.
rules.remediation: Partition datasets and reject ambiguous aggregation.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A repeated row can inflate a convincing-looking opportunity report.
rules.verification: Input validation and explicit grouping preserve scope.

rules.title: Interpret CTR and multiple-URL signals cautiously
rules.evidence_test: Inspect intent, position, feature mix and URL purpose before diagnosis.
rules.remediation: Create review leads with hypotheses rather than automatic rewrite orders.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Low CTR does not always mean a weak title.
rules.verification: Human review confirms a plausible fix before changing content.

rules.title: Use current AI report definitions
rules.evidence_test: Open current provider help and inspect actual account fields.
rules.remediation: Keep overlapping report scope and impression/citation metrics distinct.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Impressions/citations are not clicks or conversions.
rules.verification: Output names the provider metric and avoids double-counted totals.

rules.title: Separate observations from causal claims
rules.evidence_test: Record hypothesis, cohorts, releases, demand and confounders.
rules.remediation: Use proportionate controlled tests or qualified observational evidence.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A vendor case-study uplift is not a forecast for this site.
rules.verification: Report uncertainty, denominators and actual measurement design.

rules.title: Prepare a relevant URL map
rules.evidence_test: Reconcile old URLs with intended relevant destinations.
rules.remediation: Create reviewed mappings and explicit removal exceptions.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Not every old URL has a useful successor.
rules.verification: Automated redirect tests plus content-equivalence samples.

rules.title: Validate deployment and rollback
rules.evidence_test: Inspect approvals, baseline, canary plan, stop conditions and rollback.
rules.remediation: Create a controlled release plan with owner and reversible configuration.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A successful build does not verify deployed SEO behaviour.
rules.verification: Run actual post-release route/header/content checks and record rollback readiness.

rules.title: Diagnose traffic drops before mass changes
rules.evidence_test: Segment dates/pages/devices/markets and check tracking plus releases.
rules.remediation: Investigate evidence-ranked causes before broad content or index changes.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Timing near an algorithm update does not prove a penalty.
rules.verification: A diagnosis cites actual evidence and monitored correction results.

rules.title: Inspect Bing evidence independently
rules.evidence_test: Use available Bing diagnostics and current official guidance.
rules.remediation: Report actual Bing status rather than copying Google conclusions.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Missing Bing access must stay not-tested.
rules.verification: Findings identify the real tool/account and evidence date.

rules.title: Reverify policy when source retrieval is incomplete
rules.evidence_test: Open current Webmaster Guidelines in a capable browser.
rules.remediation: Mark blocked guidance unavailable and avoid claims about unread content.
rules.false_positive_caveat: A JavaScript shell is not substantive policy review.
rules.verification: Source record reflects actual access and applicable sections.

rules.title: Treat snippet controls as excerpt policy
rules.evidence_test: Review current supported markup and real content-owner intent.
rules.remediation: Apply only authorised excerpt policy without pretending it is security.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Page indexability and confidentiality are different from snippet selection.
rules.verification: Inspect resulting DOM and current provider behaviour documentation.

rules.title: Notify actual owned-URL changes through IndexNow
rules.evidence_test: Check ownership, existing integration, real change events and current protocol.
rules.remediation: Use scoped deduplicated notifications with robust error handling.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Submission does not guarantee crawl/indexing and is not universal Google submission.
rules.verification: Check accepted requests separately from later search visibility.

rules.title: Respect Google Indexing API eligibility
rules.evidence_test: Compare content type with current allowed API use.
rules.remediation: Do not submit ordinary pages through an inapplicable restricted API.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Adding deceptive job/video markup does not create eligibility.
rules.verification: Record documented eligibility and explicit action permission.

rules.title: Do not require speculative AI files or formatting
rules.evidence_test: Compare proposed tactic with current official AI guidance.
rules.remediation: Use useful content and actual technical requirements; label experiments.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Another consumer may have a legitimate separate llms.txt use.
rules.verification: Recommendation makes no unsupported Google ranking/citation promise.

rules.title: Keep training, search and snippet controls distinct
rules.evidence_test: Identify actual product, crawler and owner policy.
rules.remediation: Verify provider-specific mechanisms before making scoped changes.
rules.false_positive_caveat: One bot directive does not control every AI/search surface.
rules.verification: Document intended product impact and verify applicable settings.

rules.title: Do not manufacture authority for generated answers
rules.evidence_test: Inspect citations, entities, reviews and claimed expertise for truth.
rules.remediation: Provide substantiated useful information without planted names or endorsements.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Citation appearance is not independent fact verification.
rules.verification: Editorial owner validates every material factual/authority claim.

rules.title: Verify outcomes and disclose unfinished work
rules.evidence_test: Compare stated work with actual commands, evidence and approvals.
rules.remediation: Separate deployed checks, engine uptake and business outcomes.
rules.false_positive_caveat: Tests written or scheduled but not run are not successful tests.
rules.verification: Handoff lists completed, failed, blocked and untested checks with evidence.
